services.title: Everything your brand needs
services.intro: One contractor instead of ten. Our own equipment lines, direct import of products and consumables, partners in Uzbekistan, China, Russia, Europe, the USA and Dubai. No middlemen — shorter lead times and lower prices.

print.title: Print shop
print.short: Full-cycle printing: from business cards to catalogues and packaging. Express printing available.
body: For over ten years our full-cycle print shop has produced high-quality printed materials at affordable prices: leaflets and business cards (including custom die-cut shapes), flyers and brochures, catalogues, posters and banners of any complexity and for any budget.

Corporate print — we outfit your company to the highest standard: brand identity, letterheads, folders, diaries. Advertising print — vivid imagery for brands. Packaging print — our technical designers develop the dieline and offer the best option for price and quality.
No time to wait? Express printing: top quality in the shortest possible time.

promo.title: Promotional products
promo.tagline: The personality and style of your brand
promo.short: Branded merchandise in wholesale quantities: pens, mugs, USB drives, umbrellas, gift sets. Direct import.
body: We produce and sell promotional and office products in wholesale quantities. Pens, notebooks, mugs, USB drives, umbrellas, key rings and much more with your company logo — made from quality materials built to last.
Our wide range of in-house equipment lets us apply your logo to almost any surface: UV printing, laser engraving, heat transfer, gold foil stamping.

Direct sourcing: you're not limited to the local market. If the product you need isn't available in Uzbekistan, we'll bring it from China, Russia, Europe, the USA or Dubai — or suggest unique alternatives.

textile.title: Textiles
textile.short: T-shirts, hoodies, workwear, gowns, bags. DTF printing, embroidery, screen printing.
body: Our own textile workshop sews and brands corporate and promo apparel — T-shirts, polos, hoodies, jackets, vests, workwear — as well as gowns, aprons, towels, blankets and bags.

Any decoration method: DTF printing gives vivid full-colour artwork that withstands washing; we also offer screen printing, embroidery and heat transfer. Runs from a small batch to outfitting an entire chain's staff.

pos.title: POS and retail fixtures
pos.short: Stands, displays, dispensers, counters, showcases, shelving and reception desks with your brand.
body: We design and manufacture everything that works at the point of sale: from paper and plastic POS materials to retail furniture and structures. One manufacturer, one quality standard, one look across every store in the chain.
POS materials: floor and counter stands, displays, dispensers, shelf talkers, wobblers, price tag holders, wire and mesh products, sheet plastic items with full-colour printing.

Retail fixtures: counters, showcases, shelving, island units, reception desks, trade stands. Metal, laminated board, MDF, acrylic, glass; powder coating and lighting in-house. We draw it up, make a sample, produce the batch and install it on site. Warranty from 1 to 5 years.

exhibition.title: Exhibition stands
exhibition.tagline: Turnkey stands for trade shows and forums
exhibition.short: Design, fabrication, installation and dismantling of exhibition stands of any complexity.
body: We design and build exhibition stands turnkey: from sketch and 3D visualisation to on-site installation and dismantling after the event. Mobile, modular and custom-built structures to fit the brief and the budget.

Everything is made in-house: steel and timber frames, panels, lighting, full-colour print, branding, furniture and multimedia. The stand arrives at the show ready, so your team only takes care of the visitors.
We work with trade shows, forums and presentations in Tashkent and the regions, and we always make the opening date.

heraldry.title: Heraldry
heraldry.short: Medals, orders, lapel pins, coins — including gold and silver.
body: A dedicated division with a full production cycle for award and souvenir items of any complexity — from pins to state decorations in precious metals (gold, silver).
We'll develop an exclusive turnkey design or refine your existing sketch of an order, medal, lapel badge or corporate award. We also make souvenir coins, key rings and statuettes.
Ordered for honouring distinguished citizens and long-serving employees, company anniversary gifts, sports competition awards, celebrations and events, and souvenir retail.

outdoor.title: Outdoor advertising
outdoor.short: Channel letters, lightboxes, rooftop installations, signs, LED panel installation.
body: A modern production facility equipped with every type of machine used for outdoor advertising. Full cycle: engineering, design, manufacturing, installation and maintenance.
We make channel and illuminated letters, lightboxes, rooftop installations, signs, pylons and totems, and install LED panels and media screens. Warranty up to 5 years.

interior.title: Interior branding
interior.short: Turnkey fit-out of sales offices, retail points and showrooms: signs, wayfinding, wall branding.
body: We fit out sales offices, retail points, showrooms and corporate spaces turnkey: from design concept to installation.

Interior signs and logos, wall and window branding, lighting elements, wayfinding, reception areas, photo zones and interior printing — all made in-house. For chains — one standard of fit-out in every branch.

custom.title: Custom projects
custom.short: Products built to your idea: from sketch and drawings to sample, batch and installation.
body: If the product you need isn't in any catalogue, we'll engineer and make it. Our designers and technologists draw it up, select materials and technology, and produce a sample for approval.
Art objects, installations, exhibition structures, custom packaging, executive gifts — of any complexity, with installation and warranty.

about.title: A full-cycle production company
about.lead: Reklama Centr is an advertising production company in Tashkent. We do one thing: make high-quality advertising products at the best possible price — from a business card to a rooftop sign.
body: Our own equipment and specialists let us serve corporate clients of any scale. In-house equipment lines, direct import of products and consumables, and a wide circle of partners in Uzbekistan, China, Russia, Europe, the USA and Dubai mean we work without middlemen — clients get results faster and at better prices.

Our specialists are experienced professionals with a high level of education who will help create artwork, design and projects of any complexity. Our managers quickly prepare the best offer for your business.

We guarantee a refund or replacement for defects and offer an unprecedented 3–5 year warranty on our products. Regular clients enjoy flexible discounts, bonuses and a 'get it now, pay later' credit line.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Didn't find the answer? Write to us — a manager will advise on materials, lead times and pricing.

items.a: It depends on the job. Standard items are priced fast — as soon as we have the dimensions, quantity or a description. Complex objects — rooftop installations, exhibition stands, retail fixtures — are priced after a sketch or a site survey, and we tell you the exact timing when you get in touch.

items.q: Do I need a finished layout?
items.a: No. Our designer will develop the layout to your brief, a technologist will prepare the technical specification, and before production we show the product as a 3D visualisation. If you already have a layout, send it in any format: PDF, AI, CDR, PNG.

The warranty depends on the product: from 1 to 5 years. We state the exact term for your order in the quote and fix it in the contract. If there is a defect we refund or replace the item, and we service installed structures for the whole warranty period.

We work under a contract. The prepayment depends on the project — its scope, complexity and deadline — and we state it in the quote. Regular corporate clients get a resident card: it lets you order with no prepayment and no queue. That helps when a payment cannot be made over the weekend but the finished run is needed on Monday morning. Regular clients also get a flexible system of discounts and bonuses.
Yes. Installation crews under our supervision install signs, rooftop structures, stands and retail fixtures and service them afterwards.

Yes. We deliver across Uzbekistan and take on the transport risks, and installation crews travel to the regions. Products and materials come directly from partners in China, Russia, Europe, the USA and Dubai, with no middlemen — that keeps the cost low from the start and gives you a better price.

For outdoor advertising, fixtures and stands — from a single item. For promo products, apparel and print the minimum batch depends on the printing technology — we will price your volume and tell you where the unit price gets better.

items.q: Can you make it in time for our event?
items.a: We run a dedicated shift for rush orders. Tell us the date — we will plan production, delivery and installation so that everything is ready ahead of time.

case.title: INFINITY: engineering without equal
case.text: For the premium INFINITY residence by Golden House we engineered, built and lifted dynamic illuminated letters over 3.5 metres tall onto the roof. There are no trusses: each letter stands on its own column, carried by a spar system borrowed from shipbuilding. The installation required the largest mobile crane in Uzbekistan, and assembling it took two 60-tonne cranes and three flatbed loads of components. Today the sign can be seen from the Vodnik district.
case.factSub: a dedicated column for every letter
